title: Read independently authorized Govern Response Result in existing Command Incident Detail
goal: Complete a bounded Class-0 Govern→Command Result consumption in existing authenticated Incident Detail without mutating Incident, Run, Decision or Result. Shared owner authorizes Incident→Result relation and Govern owner independently checks perm.govern.result.read before provenance/outcome/residual risk are displayed.
invariants: Command owns Incident; Govern owns canonical Result, Run and Decision; Shared Object Linking owns stable Incident→Result relation. Readable Incident or relation cannot imply Result.read.

Existing Incident Detail reauthorizes selected Incident using Command SessionResolver and Owner.List+CanRead Project before the optional Shared and Govern source calls. No browser-supplied Result ID or principal ever participates in the new lookup.

Only exact authorized Result IDs, tenant/environment, version/source identity, Run reference, lifecycle, classification, verification and residual risk are displayed via existing safe html/template; denied Result omitted without leaking ID/existence/count.
No technical executor raw payload, Evidence, Finding, Decision, target-level result, mutation, Result finalization, automatic Incident status update or Govern Action Request is executed.
No condition claims a runtime success as independently verified when verification has failed; missing projection never means absence of underlying Govern Result.
Historic #211 SHA and its independent L2 remain immutable; no change in #211 source or branch. New Git base #211 is not product/engineering parent.
security_properties: Fail closed and emit no partial Incident HTML on link scope/duplicate/excessive refs, Govern owner error, source ID/tenant/env mismatch, malformed UTF8/control text, invalid timestamp or revoked Request context.
At most eight cross-owner Result read calls per Incident; independent Result.read must be server-enforced, not inferred from Incident.read or Shared link.
Only fixed existing GET /command/incident-detail and strict no-store/CSP HTML, no arbitrary Result route, no new authentication mechanism.

migration.rationale: Optional bounded read-only projection on preexisting HTML Incident Detail, no data model or persistent storage changes

rollback.strategy: Revert optional WithResults constructor and local synthetic source; legacy constructor and HTML continue to work
verification: Legacy Command Incident Detail remains partial and successful
No upstream PR SHA change or schema migration

outputs: The existing local Incident Detail now displays bounded Govern-authorized Result outcome, verification, residual risk, provenance and referenced Run ID
Source with denied Govern result is omitted without ID/count; absent provider yields explicitly partial Result unavailable state
Go handler tests for authorized/dropped Results, malicious identities, failures, revoked Incident, plus real localhost multi-principal HTTP browser tests

Readable Incident to commander without Govern grant renders no Result or ID, even if Shared relation exists; exact lookup is per-result
Malformed/refused/foreign/duplicated/too-many references or poisoned Result record abort whole output before HTML, while missing/denied individual Result is omitted
Legacy handler without optional sources keeps existing Incident/Alert/Case HTML and explicit partial unavailable state
Go runtime tests, race, vet, cross-platform host and engineering/security mandatory checks pass on exact candidate SHA
